usedFor: Shopify records order cancellations, and SmartTask turns each “Order Cancelled” into work through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Task” in SmartTask
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order gets a task straight away, so a refund or restock check is not forgotten.

watchOut: Each cancellation makes its own “Create Task” run, so expect one task per cancelled order.
